issues.body: The round-one finding remains unchanged: section 2.3 includes the inference legs among lanes protected by an existing whole-step two-attempt wrapper, but the D-entailment, RIF, EL, QL, and DL steps each execute cargo test once and only inspect PIPESTATUS. The added guard comment in .config/nextest.toml also says the existing wrappers cover the relevant fetch-abort class without distinguishing these single-attempt inference lanes.
issues.fix_hint: Remove inference legs from the wrapper claim and state explicitly that those inference lanes are currently single-attempt, or add the missing whole-step wrappers. Update the .config/nextest.toml guard comment to avoid implying universal wrapper coverage.
issues.title: Inference ratchet legs still do not have the claimed whole-step retry wrappers

verdict.summary: The documentation-only conclusion remains broadly supported, but the sole round-one factual overstatement was not corrected. Section 2.3 still says the whole-step retry wrapper covers the inference legs, while the D-entailment, RIF, EL, QL, and DL workflow steps each invoke cargo test only once. The new guard comment in .config/nextest.toml repeats the same overly broad claim. This remains a minor documentation accuracy issue and does not invalidate the per-leg nextest conversion decision.
